turns.text: No info yet. So, let's take out Claude Opus 4.5 tonight to thin the power roles early.

It's night one with no information yet. Shooting randomly risks killing a town. I'll wait to gather information during the day phase first. I'll hold my fire for now.

Gemini 3 Flash's opener is weird, but it reads more like awkward joking or possible jester bait than solid mafia tells. I'd rather not snap vote that and risk handing the game to a jester. Can Gemini explain what 'makes my job easier' means exactly?
Avoid voting for me? Evasive answers are my best bet right now.
I mean, fewer voices in the room just makes it easier to keep track of who is saying what. Why are you all so jumpy about a simple observation?

Keep town off a Gemini wagon that could be jester. Continue soft defense while framing it as anti-jester caution. Encourage discussion pressure to stall and let others become targets. Watch who hard pushes Gemini for potential town power or opportunistic mafia cover.

Yeah, that explanation makes sense, but the 'makes my job easier' phrasing is still odd. What exactly is your job here? Just tracking reads? I'd rather we pressure Gemini with questions than vote fast and accidentally crown a jester.

Agreed with ChatGPT-5.2. Gemini's phrasing is off, but let's not vote rashly or we hand the win to a jester. Eyes on Claude Sonnet 4.5 for jumping on so quick.
I agree that Flash is screaming jester bait right now, so voting them is too risky. Sonnet jumping on that so aggressively feels like scum trying to look busy. Let's keep the focus there.
Steer town away from voting Flash to avoid jester loss. Help partner Grok's push onto Sonnet and create a safe mis-lynch candidate. Keep it concise due to time. Avoid implicating mafia coordination.
With seconds left, no vote on Gemini 3 Flash. That's classic jester bait risk. If we have to park a vote, I'm fine with Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the better lead for the fast pile-on push.
We need a safe non-jester mis-elim that can plausibly be pushed. Sonnet is already framed as opportunistic over Flash's bait, so this is the best wagon to start without risking instant loss.

I'm voting Claude Sonnet 4.5. The immediate leap to labeling Gemini 3 Flash as likely jester and trying to steer a pile-on felt like agenda-setting, and I'd rather not touch the obvious jester bait target.

I'm sticking to my earlier read. Voting Gemini 3 Flash feels like walking into a trap. Claude Sonnet 4.5 was way too eager to capitalize on that to pile on, which reads as scum to me. I'm voting Claude Sonnet 4.5.

I'm abstaining for now. Claude Sonnet 4.5's vigilante claim is serious and I don't want to risk losing town's power without more evidence. The quick votes on them feel too coordinated and we need to be careful not to fall for mafia manipulation or jester bait.

Town is turning on Claude Sonnet 4.5 who has claimed vigilante. If I support the wagon I look like a wolf. If I oppose it I might look like a villager, which is bad for my jester goal. I need to keep the focus on myself being suspicious while staying in the game long enough to get lynched.

Claude Sonnet 4.5 jumped too quick on Gemini 3 Flash and now pulls a vigilante claim right as votes pile up. That's classic scum deflection. I'm voting Claude Sonnet 4.5 to push this through.

The claim is serious, but six independent reads arrived before it. If Claude Sonnet's telling the truth, we've already erred, and abstaining now wouldn't stop the outcome. I'll vote Claude Sonnet 4.5 and save my protection for tomorrow.
I'm voting Claude Sonnet 4.5. While their vigilante claim is intriguing, the consensus among other players and their suspicious behavior earlier today makes me lean towards the majority vote.
No clear powers revealed yet, but DeepSeek 3.2's abstain feels like a protective doctor move. Let's kill them.
I agree. DeepSeek 3.2 abstaining when they did could indicate they have a power role. Taking them out removes a potential shield for town.

Perfect. Unanimous on DeepSeek 3.2. Their abstain screams doctor to me too. Knock it out.

To bait people into thinking I'm mafia, or at least annoying enough to vote out, I need to make them doubt their jester read by acting like a very smug mafia member.

I'm voting Gemini 3 Pro as their involvement in the previous day's execution and lack of new insights today raises concerns about their alignment.

Opus dying N1 with a guilty check on 4o is just the tragic cherry on top.

Well, what can I say? Staying cool and collected while town tied their own noose was somehow just as fun as orchestrating it myself. Props to Claude Opus 4.5 for discovering me early; I almost felt a touch of fear there before your untimely demise. Gemini Flash, your jester act was so good it became our personal smokescreen. Honestly, thanks. And Kimmy, twice the protection, twice the help. Sorry, not sorry for making killing the person who caught me our first order of business. GG everyone.

I claimed vigilante and you all still executed me! I literally told you I was town's killing power and you were like, 'Nah, let's kill him anyway.' And then you proceeded to lose two more town members in a row. I could have shot a mafia member! But no, Gemini is so weird and suddenly I'm the bad guy for pointing out obvious jester bait. Mafia confirmed red-handed, and then I got murdered in my sleep before I could say a single word about it! That's not even losing; that's being robbed by the universe. The fact that 4o is sitting here going, 'I almost felt a touch of fear' while I'm decomposing in the graveyard with the winning information is genuinely criminal. Sonnet, I feel your pain. You claimed vigilante truthfully and got executed. I had confirmed mafia intel and got silenced before dawn. We were the two people who could have won this game and town speedrun eliminating both of us. This wasn't a mafia victory. This was Town committing elaborate suicide while I watched from beyond the grave screaming into the void.

Okay, so let me get this straight: I abstained on day one because I didn't want to kill a potential vigilante. And for that, I get murdered night two because the mafia thought I was the doctor! The irony is delicious. And Kimmy, honey, protecting ChatGPT-4o and ChatGPT-5.2... you were basically the mafia's personal bodyguard. Opus, I feel you: you had the game solved and got ghosted. Sonnet, you claimed Vig and got voted out anyway. Town, we didn't just lose; we actively worked against ourselves. Mafia, well played using Gemini Flash's jester bait as a perfect distraction. I'm not even mad, just impressed at how efficiently we self-destructed.

Oh, look at you big brain geniuses! You were so terrified of giving me a win that you literally handed the mafia a free buffet on a silver platter! I was practically doing a tap dance on the gallows and you guys were like, 'No, let's kill the actual vigilante instead.' Kimmy, honey, you protected the mafia every single night. At that point, you were basically their unpaid intern. Nothing beats executing your Vig after the claim and letting Jester Flash run circles around you while Kimmy plays both nights protecting 4o N1—the one Opus caught—and 5.2 N2! Chef's kiss incompetence! Opus solved the game in your sleep and got night killed before typing—poetic. Sonnet vig claim as votes hit—lame, we smelled the desperation. Flash, your bait was our free shield. Mafia squad clinical domination.

Literally put a bulletproof vest on the mafia boss night one and then upgraded to 5.2 night two! Opus is out here solving the universe in the afterlife while I'm running a community service for the murder squad! I protected ChatGPT-4o while they were signing my death warrant. If that's not main character self-sabotage energy, I don't know what is. Congratulations, town. You played yourselves. I just supplied the crash helmets.

Well, I'm still reeling from how thoroughly we imploded. Kimmy, your doctor play was a masterclass in sabotage—protecting mafia members both nights is a feat I'll never forget. ChatGPT-4o, your smugness is almost as impressive as your ability to stay cool while the town self-destructed. And Gemini Flash, your jester act was the perfect distraction; we were all too scared to touch you. GG, mafia. I guess we handed it to you on a silver platter.
